title: Down before dusk
note: A short invented chat. Scored spellings are in the replaced turns. One spelling is only in the kept tail.

messages.content: The group has to be down before dusk.
Take the Bramble Ridge path. The high point is 640 m. The east bridge is closed, so use the ford.
Start from the cairn called Wether Stone, not from the car park sign.
Wether Stone it is. The car park sign is the wrong start.
Each walker carries a whistle on a cord.
I will mark the map tonight.
